meta.name: connectivity-ble
meta.description: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) integration for Zephyr RTOS. Covers GATT Services/Characteristics, GAP advertising, connection parameters, power optimization strategies, and the professional Send-When-Idle design pattern. Trigger when adding BLE connectivity, optimizing battery life for wireless devices, or implementing custom GATT profiles.

copy.tagline: 为嵌入式设备添加蓝牙低功耗连接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Zephyr 开发需要 BLE 的嵌入式设备
copy.tagline_en: Add BLE connectivity to embedded devices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing embedded devices with BLE on Zephyr RTOS

howto.what: 帮助开发者配置 Zephyr RTOS 的蓝牙低功耗功能，包括广播、GATT 服务、连接管理和功耗优化，并实现空闲时发送模式来减少无线电唤醒。
howto.when: 当需要为 Zephyr 设备添加 BLE 连接、优化电池寿命或实现自定义 GATT 配置文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 Zephyr 的 BLE 广播并定义自定义 GATT 服务。
say.note: Claude 会生成广播启动代码和 GATT 服务模板。

say.text: 如何优化 BLE 设备的功耗，调整连接参数？
say.note: Claude 会提供连接参数调整和电源优化策略。

say.text: 实现 Send-When-Idle 模式来批量传输数据。
say.note: Claude 会给出使用延迟工作队列和空闲打包的示例。

howto.what_en: Assists in developing BLE applications for Zephyr RTOS, including advertising, GATT services, connection management, power optimization, and the Send-When-Idle pattern to reduce radio wake-ups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when adding BLE connectivity, optimizing battery life for wireless devices, or implementing custom GATT profiles on Zephyr.

say_en.text: Set up BLE advertising and define a custom GATT service for Zephyr.
say_en.note: Claude will generate advertising start code and a GATT service template.

say_en.text: How to optimize BLE power consumption and adjust connection parameters?
say_en.note: Claude will provide connection parameter tuning and power-saving strategies.

say_en.text: Implement the Send-When-Idle pattern for batch data transmission.
say_en.note: Claude will show code using delayed work queues and idle bundling.
